name: Arturo Uslar Pietri
contribution: A Venezuelan intellectual, historian, writer, television producer, and politician.
legacy: In his works he championed mestizaje, or miscegenation, as a valuable feature of Latin American culture.

checks.lead: Arturo Uslar Pietri (16 May 1906 in Caracas – 26 February 2001) was a Venezuelan intellectual, historian, writer, television producer, and politician.
